Actual having-died-away aorist participle is rendered die under the English modal purpose frame; the original participial form remains.
Actual dative article/righteousness supplies to-righteousness with the same nominal head.
Actual relative whose identifies the bruise owner, rendered possessive His without changing the source relative form.
Actual dative article/bruise supplies By ... stripes as the means relation. The source bruise is singular, rendered plural stripes.
Actual aorist passive healing predicate is rendered present you-are-healed; its Greek tense remains aorist.

2:25.targetText: For “you were like sheep going astray,” but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

groups.note: Actual straying present nonactive participle is rendered going-astray; no separate Greek going verb is printed.
Actual returned aorist passive is rendered you-have-returned; its original form remains.
Actual genitive article/souls supplies of ... souls with its real nominal head.
